calendarDiscovery.crawlerNotes: All three local two-page PDFs were fully extracted and visually inspected; current official downloads match by SHA-256. All are 2026-2027 variants, not successive years. The main calendar page is a JavaScript shell with no readable links; direct retrieval timed out even after an approved retry. Current official PDFs and the full official newsroom, January 23, 2025 adoption announcement, August 11, 2026 opening notice and September 3 Labor Day notice were checked. No later 2026-2027 operational change was verified. The adoption announcement independently confirms November 23-25 student Fall Recess for Elementary/Secondary and Adult/Vocational, resolving the employee-focused PDF wording. Do not transfer those dates to Juvenile Justice. Employee opt days are not student make-up reserves. Technical/adult planning days carry a principal-authorized class-swap exception. Wednesday one-hour release applies only to elementary grades 2-5 and K-8 center grades 2-8. Juvenile Justice includes 15 explicit Saturdays and two required summer grading periods. No future-year calendar was verified. schoolAgePopulation is an unset ranking placeholder, not enrollment.

faqs.question: Which Miami-Dade school calendar should I use?
faqs.answer: Use Elementary and Secondary for the regular district school schedule. Technical Colleges and Adult Education Centers have a longer trimester year. The Juvenile Justice Center uses a separate year-round calendar with summer grading periods and Saturday classes. Confirm independently operated charter-school and individual program schedules directly.

faqs.question: Are the three Miami-Dade calendars for different school years?
faqs.answer: All three calendars here are for 2026-2027. Their different ending dates reflect different programs. A 2027-2028, 2028-2029 or 2029-2030 calendar has not been verified here.

about.dataSource: The district-published 2026-2027 Elementary and Secondary calendar supplies the dates and program scope. Its two pages include the monthly grid, date explanations and scheduling footnotes. The official PDF is linked above alongside the district calendar page.
about.processing: All six pages across the three program PDFs were visually checked. This regular calendar contains only its own student-relevant dates; staff hiring, opt-work alternatives and pre/post-year planning are omitted. November 23-25 student status is confirmed by the January 23, 2025 official adoption announcement. The weekly Wednesday rule is expanded only onto actual attendance Wednesdays, with grade scope preserved. The grid reconciles to 180 days: 211 weekdays minus 31 no-class weekdays. Academic boundaries do not imply a student holiday. No 2026-2027 final-day early-dismissal announcement was verified; the newsroom’s last-three-days notice concerns 2025-2026 and is not transferred.
about.updates: Official PDF downloads and available district announcements were checked October 19, 2026. Check the district calendar page and school messages for later changes.
about.disclaimer: Use the calendar for the student’s own school or program. Building access, transportation, childcare and individual course meeting times should be confirmed with the school.

faqs.question: When is the first day of school in Miami-Dade for 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: Thursday, August 13, 2026, is the first day for elementary and secondary students in Miami-Dade County Public Schools. The first semester begins that day.

faqs.question: When is the last day of school in Miami-Dade in 2027?
faqs.answer: Thursday, June 3, 2027, is the last student day. It also marks the end of the fourth grading period and second semester. June 4 is a teacher planning day, not an additional student day.

faqs.question: When is Miami-Dade Thanksgiving break in 2026?
faqs.answer: Students have no classes Monday, November 23, through Friday, November 27, 2026. Fall Recess covers November 23-25, Thanksgiving is November 26, and November 27 is a recess day. Classes resume Monday, November 30.

faqs.question: When is winter break for Miami-Dade schools in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: Winter Recess runs from December 21, 2026, through January 1, 2027. December 18 is also a student-free teacher planning day, so the last class day before the break is December 17. Students return Monday, January 4.

faqs.question: When is Miami-Dade spring break in 2027?
faqs.answer: Spring Recess is March 22-26, 2027. Students also have no classes Monday, March 29, because of a teacher planning day. Classes resume Tuesday, March 30.

faqs.question: Which Miami-Dade students get out early on Wednesdays?
faqs.answer: Elementary school students in grades 2-5 and K-8 center students in grades 2-8 are released one hour early on Wednesdays when school is in session. This is not a districtwide early-release rule for every grade.

faqs.question: Do kindergarten and first-grade students leave early on Wednesdays?
faqs.answer: Not under this specific district calendar rule. The one-hour Wednesday early release applies to elementary grades 2-5 and K-8 center grades 2-8. Check your child's school for its regular dismissal schedule.

faqs.question: What time is Wednesday early dismissal in Miami-Dade?
faqs.answer: Eligible students leave one hour before their school's regular dismissal time. The district's annual calendar does not provide a universal dismissal time. Confirm the exact pickup time with your school.

faqs.question: Which teacher planning days have no school for students?
faqs.answer: During the student school year, there are no classes September 21, November 3 and December 18, 2026, or January 15, March 10 and March 29, 2027. November 3 is also a districtwide professional learning day.

faqs.question: Is there school on Election Day, November 3, 2026?
faqs.answer: No. Tuesday, November 3, 2026, is a districtwide professional learning and teacher planning day. The published calendar states that students do not attend school that day.

faqs.question: Does Miami-Dade have school on Columbus Day in October 2026?
faqs.answer: Yes. Monday, October 12, 2026, is a regular student attendance day on the published elementary and secondary calendar. It is not listed as a district holiday or teacher planning day. Check your school for any local schedule changes.

faqs.question: Is there school on Labor Day in Miami-Dade in 2026?
faqs.answer: No. Monday, September 7, 2026, is a student holiday on the elementary and secondary school calendar.

faqs.question: Do Miami-Dade schools have classes on Veterans Day 2026?
faqs.answer: No. Wednesday, November 11, 2026, is a student holiday, so there are no regular student classes or Wednesday early-release pickups that day.

faqs.question: Is there school on Martin Luther King Jr. Day in Miami-Dade in 2027?
faqs.answer: No. Monday, January 18, 2027, is a student holiday. Friday, January 15, is also a teacher planning day with no classes. Students return Tuesday, January 19.

faqs.question: Are Miami-Dade schools closed on Presidents Day in 2027?
faqs.answer: Yes. Monday, February 15, 2027, is a student holiday for All Presidents Day on the district's elementary and secondary calendar.

faqs.question: Do Miami-Dade students have school on Memorial Day in 2027?
faqs.answer: No. Monday, May 31, 2027, is a student holiday. Students return afterward for the final days of school, with the school year ending June 3.

faqs.question: When does the second semester start in Miami-Dade?
faqs.answer: The first semester ends January 14, 2027. After a teacher planning day on January 15 and the Martin Luther King Jr. holiday on January 18, the second semester begins Tuesday, January 19.

faqs.question: When do the four grading periods end in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The grading periods end October 16, 2026; January 14, March 19 and June 3, 2027. The second, third and fourth periods begin October 19, January 19 and March 30, respectively. These dates do not automatically mean early dismissal or a day off.

faqs.question: How many school days are in the Miami-Dade 2026-2027 calendar?
faqs.answer: The district's elementary and secondary calendar lists 180 student days, divided into grading periods of 45, 46, 42 and 47 days. Wednesdays with early dismissal still count as attendance days.

faqs.question: What does available to opt mean on the school calendar?
faqs.answer: It refers to employee workday options, not a choice for students to attend school. Teacher planning days marked as having no students remain no-class days on the published elementary and secondary calendar.

faqs.question: Are there hurricane make-up days on the Miami-Dade calendar?
faqs.answer: The published 2026-2027 elementary and secondary calendar does not identify specific hurricane make-up dates. Employee opt-work days should not be treated as student make-up days. Watch for district announcements if severe weather changes the schedule.

faqs.question: Is the last day of school an early-release day?
faqs.answer: The annual calendar does not specify a special dismissal time for Thursday, June 3, 2027. The regular Wednesday early-release rule does not establish a Thursday schedule. Confirm end-of-year pickup times with your school.

faqs.question: Does the Miami-Dade school calendar include report-card release dates?
faqs.answer: The calendar lists the end of each grading period—October 16, 2026, and January 14, March 19 and June 3, 2027—but does not give report-card release dates. Check the district Parent Portal or your child's school for those announcements.

faqs.question: Does this calendar apply to adult education and juvenile justice programs?
faqs.answer: No. Technical colleges and adult education centers have their own three-trimester calendar ending July 28, 2027. The Juvenile Justice Center has a separate year-round calendar ending June 29 and includes scheduled Saturday classes.

faqs.question: Do Miami-Dade charter schools follow this calendar?
faqs.answer: Do not assume every charter school follows the district's elementary and secondary calendar. Check directly with your child's charter school for its approved dates, early dismissals and student holidays.

faqs.question: Where can I find the official Miami-Dade school calendar and updates?
faqs.answer: Use the district-published Elementary and Secondary PDF linked on this page or the Miami-Dade County Public Schools Calendars page. For emergency changes, follow district announcements, the Dadeschools Mobile App and notices from your child's school.

editorialSummary.heading: School dates, breaks and Wednesday early dismissal
paragraphs: Miami-Dade County Public Schools (M-DCPS) begins its 2026-2027 elementary and secondary school year Thursday, August 13, 2026, and ends Thursday, June 3, 2027. The calendar lists 180 student days. Technical colleges, adult education centers and the Juvenile Justice Center follow separate schedules.

Students have no classes November 23-27, with Fall Recess followed by Thanksgiving and the Friday recess day. Winter Recess runs December 21-January 1, but December 18 is also a teacher planning day, making December 17 the last class day before the break. Students return January 4. Spring Recess is March 22-26, and a separate planning day on March 29 means students return Tuesday, March 30.

Wednesday dismissal is different for some families. Elementary school students in grades 2-5 and K-8 center students in grades 2-8 leave one hour early on Wednesdays when classes are held. The district calendar does not set one pickup time for every school, so families should check their school's bell schedule and transportation arrangements. Other no-student planning or professional-learning dates during the year include September 21, November 3, January 15 and March 10.
highlights: The district's published elementary and secondary calendar lists 180 student days.
Students have no classes throughout Thanksgiving week, November 23-27.
Spring Recess ends March 26, but students return March 30 after a teacher planning day.
Wednesday early dismissal applies only to the elementary and K-8 grades specified by the district.

faqs.question: When does the Miami-Dade technical and adult education year start?
faqs.answer: The published first day is Thursday, August 13, 2026, which begins the first trimester. Individual technical college and adult education courses may follow different meeting schedules.

faqs.question: When is the last day for Miami-Dade technical colleges and adult education centers?
faqs.answer: Wednesday, July 28, 2027, is the final student day on the published calendar and the end of the third trimester. July 29 is a staff planning day.

faqs.question: What are the three trimester dates for 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The first trimester runs August 13-December 17, 2026. The second runs January 4-April 16, 2027, and the third April 19-July 28. Holidays and teacher planning days occur within these periods, and individual course dates may differ.

faqs.question: How many school days are on the technical and adult education calendar?
faqs.answer: The district calendar lists 216 days: 82 in the first trimester, 65 in the second and 69 in the third. This is the published program total, not the number of meetings required for every individual course.

faqs.question: Is the technical and adult education calendar the same as the regular Miami-Dade school calendar?
faqs.answer: No. Technical colleges and adult education centers follow a three-trimester calendar ending July 28, 2027. The regular elementary and secondary calendar ends June 3. The two calendars also differ in their summer dates and daily scheduling rules.

faqs.question: Do Miami-Dade adult education students have Thanksgiving week off?
faqs.answer: Yes, under the published district calendar. Fall Recess is November 23-25, 2026, followed by Thanksgiving on November 26 and a recess day on November 27. The standard schedule resumes Monday, November 30.

faqs.question: When is winter break for Miami-Dade technical and adult education?
faqs.answer: Winter Recess runs December 21, 2026, through January 1, 2027. The published calendar also lists December 18 as a teacher planning day with no student classes, and the second trimester begins January 4. Check with your center about any approved class-day exchange.

faqs.question: When is spring break for technical colleges and adult education centers?
faqs.answer: Spring Recess is March 22-26, 2027. March 29 is a teacher planning day, so the standard published schedule resumes Tuesday, March 30. Confirm any center-specific class arrangement.

faqs.question: Can adult education classes be held on teacher planning days?
faqs.answer: In certain circumstances, yes. The official calendar allows a principal to approve an on-campus adult education class on a planning day instead of a regularly scheduled class day when day-school activities disrupt the program. The approval and actual class swap must be confirmed with the center.

faqs.question: Which teacher planning days should adult education students check?
faqs.answer: The published calendar lists no student classes September 21, November 3 and December 18, 2026, and January 15, March 10, March 29 and June 4, 2027. The footnote permits certain adult education class exchanges, but does not establish a replacement schedule for every program or date.

faqs.question: Does the planning-day class-swap rule apply to every technical college course?
faqs.answer: The official footnote specifically addresses on-campus adult education programs affected by activities of the day-school program. It does not announce a class swap for every technical college course. Students should follow their institution's published course schedule.

faqs.question: Do Miami-Dade technical colleges and adult education centers have summer break in 2027?
faqs.answer: The district's technical and adult education calendar does not end with the regular K-12 school year on June 3. Its third trimester continues through July 28, 2027. Individual courses may finish earlier or follow different summer schedules, so confirm your dates with your center.

faqs.question: Are Juneteenth and Independence Day holidays on the adult education calendar?
faqs.answer: Yes. Friday, June 18, 2027, is the observed Juneteenth holiday, and Monday, July 5, is the observed Independence Day holiday. Both are listed as student holidays during the third trimester.

faqs.question: Which other holidays have no classes on the technical and adult calendar?
faqs.answer: The district lists Labor Day on September 7, 2026; Veterans Day on November 11; Thanksgiving on November 26; Martin Luther King Jr. Day on January 18, 2027; All Presidents Day on February 15; and Memorial Day on May 31. School recesses and planning days are listed separately.

faqs.question: Do adult education and technical college students leave early on Wednesdays?
faqs.answer: The district's one-hour Wednesday early-release rule belongs to specified elementary and K-8 grades, not this calendar. Adult and technical students should use their own center's daytime, evening or other course timetable.

faqs.question: Does available to opt mean an adult education student can skip class?
faqs.answer: No. The calendar's opt notation concerns employee workday arrangements. Student attendance depends on the published program schedule and any center-approved changes, not on an employee's choice of workday.

faqs.question: Where can I find my Miami-Dade technical or adult education class schedule?
faqs.answer: The district calendar covers the overall program year, not individual course meeting times. Your technical college or adult education center can confirm class days, start and end times, and any approved schedule changes.

faqs.question: Where can I get the official Miami-Dade technical and adult education calendar?
faqs.answer: Use the district-published Technical Colleges and Adult Education Centers PDF linked on this page or the Miami-Dade County Public Schools Calendars page. Follow your center's notices for changes to individual classes.

editorialSummary.heading: Three trimesters, with the school year extending into July
paragraphs: Miami-Dade County Public Schools publishes a separate calendar for technical colleges and adult education centers. It begins August 13, 2026, and ends July 28, 2027. The published schedule lists 216 days across three trimesters: August 13-December 17, January 4-April 16, and April 19-July 28. Individual courses may have different meeting dates, so students should check their center's timetable.

The published calendar has no classes during Thanksgiving week, November 23-27. Winter Recess runs December 21-January 1, and Spring Recess is March 22-26. Because this calendar continues after regular elementary and secondary schools finish on June 3, it also includes student holidays on June 18 for the Juneteenth observance and July 5 for the Independence Day observance.

Teacher planning days need an extra check for on-campus adult education programs. The standard calendar lists no student classes on these dates, but a principal may authorize a class-day exchange when activities in the day-school program disrupt adult education instruction. The district calendar does not identify center-specific swaps. Confirm your actual meeting days before making work, transportation or travel plans. The elementary Wednesday early-release rule is not part of this calendar.

The third trimester ends July 28, 2027, after the regular K-12 school year has finished.
June 18 and July 5 are student holidays on this extended calendar.
An adult education class-day exchange requires principal approval and is not an automatic change for every course.

about.dataSource: The district-published 2026-2027 Juvenile Justice Center calendar supplies the dates and program scope. Its two pages include the monthly grid, date explanations and scheduling footnotes. The official PDF is linked above alongside the district calendar page.
about.processing: The local two-page PDF matches the current official download. July 2 and June 29 are derived overall program endpoints from the printed Summer 1 opening and Summer 2 closing, not verbatim First/Last Day labels. Summer periods remain part of the year-round program; only their boundaries are events, avoiding a false uninterrupted summer-session range. The grid reconciles exactly to 240 days: 259 weekdays minus 34 no-class weekdays plus 15 explicitly listed Saturdays. The grading-period figures 30, 45, 42, 46, 47 and 30 corroborate the printed total. No November 23-24 Fall Recess or elementary Wednesday dismissal is transferred. July 1 opt compensation, June 30 post-year staff planning and other employee-only alternatives are omitted. Employee opt marks do not create conditional student holidays.
about.updates: Official PDF downloads and available district announcements were checked October 19, 2026. Check the district calendar page and school messages for later changes.
about.disclaimer: Use the calendar for the student’s own school or program. Building access, transportation, childcare and individual course meeting times should be confirmed with the school.

faqs.question: When does the Miami-Dade Juvenile Justice Center 2026-2027 calendar start and end?
faqs.answer: The first student period, Summer 1, begins Thursday, July 2, 2026. The final period, Summer 2, ends Tuesday, June 29, 2027. These are the beginning and ending dates of the published year-round program calendar.

faqs.question: Does the Juvenile Justice Center start school on August 13 like regular Miami-Dade schools?
faqs.answer: No. The Juvenile Justice Center's Summer 1 period begins July 2, 2026. Its first semester begins August 19, while the regular district elementary and secondary calendar starts August 13. The schedules should not be used interchangeably.

faqs.question: What are Summer 1 and Summer 2 on the Juvenile Justice Center calendar?
faqs.answer: Summer 1 runs July 2-August 18, 2026, and Summer 2 runs May 17-June 29, 2027. The district lists 30 student days for each summer grading period. Holidays and teacher planning days interrupt these date ranges.

faqs.question: Does the Miami-Dade Juvenile Justice Center have school on Saturdays?
faqs.answer: Yes. The calendar lists 15 Saturday school dates: August 22; September 12 and 26; October 10 and 24; November 7; and December 12, 2026. In 2027, the dates are January 9 and 23; February 6 and 27; March 13; April 10 and 24; and May 8. Confirm individual attendance arrangements with the center.

faqs.question: How many school days are on the Juvenile Justice Center calendar?
faqs.answer: The official calendar lists 240 student days across six grading periods: 30, 45, 42, 46, 47 and 30 days. The published schedule includes the two summer periods and the specified Saturday school dates.

faqs.question: Does the Juvenile Justice Center have the full Thanksgiving week off?
faqs.answer: No. November 23 and 24, 2026, are not marked as recess days on this calendar. Students have no classes November 25 for teacher planning, November 26 for Thanksgiving and November 27 for recess. The published schedule resumes Monday, November 30.

faqs.question: When is winter break for the Miami-Dade Juvenile Justice Center?
faqs.answer: Winter Recess runs December 21, 2026, through January 1, 2027. December 18 is also a teacher planning day with no student classes. The third grading period and second semester begin Monday, January 4.

faqs.question: When is spring break for the Juvenile Justice Center in 2027?
faqs.answer: Spring Recess is March 22-26, 2027. Monday, March 29, is a teacher planning day with no students, and the published schedule resumes Tuesday, March 30.

faqs.question: Are Juvenile Justice Center students off August 10-12, 2026?
faqs.answer: Yes. August 10 and 12 are teacher planning days, and August 11 is also a districtwide professional learning day. The calendar states that students have no classes on all three dates. Summer 1 continues afterward through August 18.

faqs.question: Which other teacher planning days have no student classes?
faqs.answer: The calendar lists September 21, November 3, November 25 and December 18, 2026, and January 15, March 10 and March 29, 2027, as additional no-student dates. November 3 is also a districtwide professional learning day.

faqs.question: When are the Juvenile Justice Center's first and second semesters?
faqs.answer: The first semester runs August 19-December 17, 2026. The second runs January 4-May 14, 2027. Summer 1 takes place before the first semester, and Summer 2 follows the second.

faqs.question: When do the four regular grading periods end?
faqs.answer: The grading periods end October 16 and December 17, 2026, and March 5 and May 14, 2027. The second, third and fourth periods begin October 19, January 4 and March 8. These academic dates do not automatically mean students have a day off.

faqs.question: Which holidays have no classes on the Juvenile Justice Center calendar?
faqs.answer: The listed student holidays are July 3, 2026, for Independence Day observed; September 7 for Labor Day; November 11 for Veterans Day; November 26 for Thanksgiving; January 18, 2027, for Martin Luther King Jr. Day; February 15 for All Presidents Day; May 31 for Memorial Day; and June 18 for Juneteenth observed.

faqs.question: Is May 14, 2027, the last day of the Juvenile Justice Center school year?
faqs.answer: No. May 14 ends the fourth grading period and second semester, but Summer 2 begins May 17 and continues through June 29. The year-round calendar does not end when the regular semesters finish.

faqs.question: What does available to opt mean on the Juvenile Justice Center calendar?
faqs.answer: It refers to employee workday arrangements, not optional student attendance. Dates designated as teacher planning days with no students remain no-class dates on the published calendar.

faqs.question: Does the Wednesday early-release rule apply to the Juvenile Justice Center?
faqs.answer: No such one-hour Wednesday rule appears on the Juvenile Justice Center calendar. The district's recurring Wednesday early release belongs to specified elementary and K-8 grades on a separate calendar. Confirm daily class times with the center.

faqs.question: Does this calendar apply to every juvenile justice education program in Florida?
faqs.answer: No. This calendar is published by Miami-Dade County Public Schools for its Juvenile Justice Center. Other juvenile justice education providers or facilities may follow different schedules.

faqs.question: Where can families find Juvenile Justice Center class times and schedule updates?
faqs.answer: The annual calendar provides school dates but not individual daily start and dismissal times. Contact the center for student-specific arrangements, and check the district's calendar page and official notices for any changes.

editorialSummary.heading: A year-round school calendar with scheduled Saturday classes
paragraphs: Miami-Dade County Public Schools publishes a separate year-round calendar for its Juvenile Justice Center. Summer 1 begins July 2, 2026, and ends August 18, followed by the first semester beginning August 19. After the fourth grading period ends May 14, 2027, Summer 2 runs from May 17 through June 29. The district lists 240 student days across these six grading periods.

Saturday school is part of this calendar, but not every Saturday is a class day. The district lists 15 specific Saturday school dates between August 22, 2026, and May 8, 2027. Students and families should check the published dates and confirm individual attendance arrangements with the center.

Thanksgiving differs from the regular district school calendar. November 23 and 24 remain scheduled class days, followed by no classes November 25-27. Winter Recess is December 21-January 1, with December 18 also a teacher planning day and classes resuming January 4. Spring Recess is March 22-26; the March 29 planning day makes Tuesday, March 30, the next scheduled weekday for classes.
highlights: The district's Juvenile Justice Center calendar lists 240 student days.
Fifteen specific Saturdays are scheduled as school days.
Summer 1 begins July 2, 2026, and Summer 2 ends June 29, 2027.
November 23-24 are not Fall Recess days on this program's calendar.
